notes.text: Jacopo Robusti, best known as Tintoretto, was an Italian Renaissance painter of the Venetian school.
Tintoretto's contemporaries both admired and criticised the speed with which he painted and the unprecedented boldness of his brushwork.
Tintoretto's work is characterised by muscular figures, dramatic gestures and bold use of perspective, in the Mannerist style.
Tintoretto is remembered as a painter connected with Italy.
Tintoretto's recorded life dates place this profile around 1518-1594.
